subject: path-scope guard and manifest provenance design

defect_1.claim: git diff --name-only with default rename detection reports only the destination path of a rename
defect_1.reproduction: throwaway /tmp repository: `git mv state/x.json workstreams/po03/x.json` produced a diff naming only workstreams/po03/x.json, so the guard passed while a governance file was deleted
defect_1.repair: the workflow now passes --no-renames to both diff invocations

defect_2.claim: a tracked symlink under workstreams/po03/ makes the manifest hash content from outside the subtree
defect_2.reproduction: throwaway /tmp repository: workstreams/po03/link.json symlinked to state/secret.txt produced a manifest line whose digest equalled sha256(state/secret.txt)
defect_2.repair: manifest.py enumerates git modes and refuses entries with mode 120000 or 160000, and manifest_text refuses symlinks directly

detail.standing: These findings improved the mechanism but do not satisfy the commission's independent-review requirement, because producer and reviewer were the same worker.
